parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster. You can call the ListCluster operation to query the cluster ID. For more information, see [ListCluster](~~154995~~).

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource that is used. Set the value to deployment.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas convert-k8s-resource --resource-type deployment --resource-name deployment-to-convert --namespace default --cluster-id b07c8192-0000-adf4f7447720 --region cn-hangzhou
